paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption: Training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B on the Easy and Hard training set.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the training rewards of different language models over a series of steps. The x-axis, labeled “Steps,” is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 50. The y-axis, labeled “Training Rewards,” is also linear, ranging from 0 to 0.4, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.05. A solid blue line represents the “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” model, which begins at a reward of approximately 0.0, increases to a peak reward of approximately 0.3 at around 100 steps, and then gradually declines to a final reward of approximately 0.2 at 500 steps. A red dashed line represents the “Llama-LUFFY-Easy” model, which begins at a reward of approximately 0.0, increases to approximately 0.3 at 250 steps, and then decreases to a final reward of approximately 0.2 at 500 steps. A pink shaded area surrounds both of these lines, indicating the uncertainty in the reward estimates. Below this plot is a second plot that depicts the training rewards of the same models. In this plot, the x-axis, labeled “Steps,” is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 50. The y-axis, labeled “Training Rewards,” is also linear, ranging from 0 to 0.1, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.01. A solid black line represents the “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” model, which begins at a reward of approximately 0.0, increases to a peak reward of approximately 0.1 at around 100 steps, and then gradually declines to a final reward of approximately 0.0 at 500 steps. A red dashed line represents the “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” model, which begins at a reward of approximately 0.0, increases to approximately 0.08 at 200 steps, and then decreases to a final reward of approximately 0.0 at 500 steps. A pink shaded area surrounds both of these lines, indicating the uncertainty in the reward estimates.
